---
title: "Spike A: crosstalk FilterHandle"
format: html
---

```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(crosstalk)
library(plotly)
library(DT)
source("common.R")

group <- "cars"
# Key defaults to rownames, so both SharedData objects link up by car name.
sd_plot  <- SharedData$new(mtcars, group = group)
sd_table <- SharedData$new(mtcars[, c("mpg", "cyl", "disp", "hp", "wt", "gear", "am")], group = group)

filters <- list(
  cyl  = list(input = "radio",    label = "Cylinders"),
  gear = list(input = "dropdown", label = "Gears"),
  am   = list(input = "radio",    label = "Transmission", default = "1")
)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
htmltools::tagList(
  crosstalk::crosstalkLibs(),
  spike_dep("qr-spike-crosstalk", "sink_crosstalk.js"),
  spike_filters(mtcars, group, rownames(mtcars), filters)
)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
plot_ly(sd_plot, x = ~mpg, y = ~hp, color = ~factor(cyl), type = "scatter", mode = "markers")
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
datatable(sd_table)
```
